name: Marchosias
source:
"I understand. You guys are losers. Dogs loitering in front of me are just eyesores. Hurry up and disappear."
He has a lot of pride, a demon with refined arrogance.
For the sake of a certain goal he wants to quickly gain the power of Solomon's descendents.
